lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Another cramped day shift. Everyone on this floor is whispering about the basement again.

lines.speaker: Best Friend
lines.text: Don't go down there. I barely slept last night—just finish your stack and head home.

lines.speaker: Clipping
lines.text: Archived article: Couple executed for the murder of the Governor's wife. Their orphaned son had no deed in his name.

lines.speaker: Permit
lines.text: Demolition order approved by the Governor's office. Tower foundation poured directly over the demolished childhood home.

lines.speaker: Memo
lines.text: Night maintenance reports organic residue near the sub-basement brickwork. Floor sealed after 7:00 PM.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: That's one of our group's ID cards—cracked and covered in dark slime near the service elevator.

lines.speaker: Survivor
lines.text: Wait—look at the torn collar tangled in those tentacles. That's him.

lines.speaker: MC
lines.text: Get to the stairwell! I'll pull the manual lock from inside—just hold it off until the 6:00 AM shift change!

lines.speaker: 6:00 AM
lines.text: The morning shift bell cuts through the stairwell as sunlight breaks the basement curse.

lines.speaker: Best Friend
lines.text: No... what did I do? All of you... I couldn't wake up.
